failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 states: 'The claim is FALSE. According to passage [1], John Gavin Malkovich did appear in "Rounders" (1998)... The claim incorrectly asserts that Malkovich had NOT played in this film, when in fact he was part of the cast.' However, the claim actually states that Rounders 'is the movie that John Gavin Malkovich had not played in' - meaning Malkovich did NOT appear in it. The passage from John Malkovich's filmography lists 'Rounders' among his films, which means Malkovich DID appear in Rounders. Therefore, the claim is correctly identified as false, but the solver's reasoning inverts the logic: it says the claim 'incorrectly asserts that Malkovich had NOT played in this film' when the claim does make that assertion and it is incorrect because he was in the film.
